The '''''Skinchanger''''' was a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] that was [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[Prit Kessek]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] who worked for the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] as a courier, while the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Kloofus]] acted as the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] second-in-command. At some point during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the ''Skinchanger'' traveled to [[Bazarre]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Mosu system]], to pick up some [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] that were to be taken to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]] on the behalf of the shipping magnate [[Brevis Taug]]. The transport landed in [[Docking Bay 117]] aboard the station and there, a group of agents who were investigating the transfer of Taug's funds attacked Kessek and Kloofus, and they seized control of the ship. The agents then flew to the space station [[Besh gate]], in orbit of Zygerria, where the Zygerrian ship [[Scourge (yacht)|''Scourge'']] was waiting to rendezvous with Kessek.
